articles.title: Mistral AI just released a text-to-speech model it says beats ElevenLabs — and it's giving away the weights for free
articles.summary: The enterprise voice AI market is in the middle of a land grab. ElevenLabs and IBM announced a collaboration just this week to bring premium voice capabilities into IBM's watsonx Orchestrate platform. Google Cloud has been expanding its Chirp 3 HD voices. OpenAI continues to iterate on its own speech synthesis.
